title: Bind every required telemetry item to its emitting source

facts.note: Required items come only from acceptance decisions; the rule applies to the existing acceptance state, not only when an acceptance is changed.

values: acceptance state: telemetry disposition required with at least one resolvable concrete telemetry URN
facts.note: Requires parsing all current acceptance decisions (changed or unchanged) for telemetry disposition=required and resolving their URNs.

values: non-test implementation source (any directory; test files excluded)
facts.note: Bindings count from every resolved `// Telemetry:` header in non-test source, with no directory restriction.

values: bun_telemetry_code: required item with no implementation binding
facts.note: Set difference (required items minus implementation bindings) computed by the bun_telemetry_code validator over the whole repository; only active once the telemetry rule family is adopted.

fires: An existing acceptance with required telemetry disposition lists a concrete URN and no non-test source file carries a resolved `// Telemetry:` header naming it — even if the current change touches no source.
An acceptance-only change adds a required concrete URN that no non-test source binds.
The only `// Telemetry:` header naming a required URN sits in a test file.
The emitting source is removed or its `// Telemetry:` header is deleted while the acceptance still requires the item.
doesNotFire: The repository has not adopted the telemetry rule family (rule is inert).
The acceptance's telemetry disposition is not required.
The required URN is unresolvable — that is the acceptance-decision rule's finding, not this one's.
At least one non-test source file, in any directory, already binds the required item via a resolved `// Telemetry:` header.

given: An acceptance in the repository (changed or not) has telemetry disposition required and lists a resolvable concrete telemetry URN (a required item)
when: the repository's acceptances and non-test source are in that state, regardless of which files the current change touches
then: Bind the required item to at least one non-test implementation source file with a `// Telemetry: <urn>` header that resolves to it.
prefer: Put the header `// Telemetry: <urn>` (the required item's exact URN) in the non-test source file that actually emits the item; the header must resolve the way coder.bun.telemetry-source-binding defines — fix resolution failures under that rule.
If nothing emits the item, drop the requirement from the acceptance instead of inventing a binding.
avoid: Binding the required item only from a test file — test headers do not count as implementation.
Adding a `// Telemetry:` header to source that does not emit the item just to silence the finding.
Leaving a required item no source claims: telemetry the plan believes in and the code has never heard of.
unless: The repository has not yet adopted the telemetry rule family — the rule is inert until adoption, like every rule in this family.
why: Traceability needs all three legs — planned, implemented, tested; this rule closes the implemented leg so a required item is never planned yet unemitted.
evidence: bun_telemetry_code reports no finding for this rule: every required item has a resolved `// Telemetry:` header in non-test source.
Reviewer can point, for each required URN of every acceptance, to the non-test source file whose header names it, or to the removal of the requirement.
verifier_detail: Required items: concrete telemetry URNs collected from acceptance decisions whose telemetry disposition is required.
Implementation bindings: every resolved `// Telemetry:` header in non-test source (no directory restriction) — the source-to-telemetry edge resolved by coder.bun.telemetry-source-binding.

Finding = required items minus implementation bindings; report it at the tracking-plan item's own file, because that is where the remedy starts (bind the emitting source or stop requiring what nothing emits).
An unresolvable required URN is the acceptance-decision rule's finding and is not double-reported here.

Fix hint shape (source fix_hint verbatim, application-specific example kept as provenance only): `// src/.../accept-response.ts` followed by `// Telemetry: telemetry:metric:be:commons:response-invocation-accepted:duration`.
Inert until the telemetry rule family is adopted.
audit: Source name: 'Required telemetry is bound to its implementation'.
Framing: third leg of the traceability tripod (planned, implemented, tested); this rule closes the second (implemented) leg.

sharedNodes.text: Disposition strict: atdd-bun fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.justification: The source states an unconditional repository-wide obligation; the When field must be filled and is phrased as a standing state so as not to narrow it to source-editing activity.

additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-pattern implied by 'bind the emitting source'; makes the obligation non-gameable.
